title: Operator-PII review workflow (opt-out / approximate-area; pii_review recorded)
context: Many small food pantries and community fridges are operated by individuals from their home addresses or personal phones. Publishing this information exposes private individuals' PII. The project must have a documented, reviewable process for identifying and minimizing operator PII before any entry is published. The pii_review field in the schema is the auditable record of this decision. Recipient/client PII is impossible by schema construction; this task covers the harder operator-PII edge case. Depends on food-maps-schema-001 for the pii_review field definition.
objective: Produce a documented operator-PII review workflow and decision tree that: (1) defines criteria for identifying plausibly-private individual addresses/phones (vs. public organizational contacts); (2) specifies the preferred handling — use the operator's published public channel; (3) defines the opt-out / approximate-area path (show approximate area + public contact instead of exact address/personal phone) for cases where a private individual's details are implicated; (4) specifies how pii_review is recorded (clear or operator-pii-minimized) and who reviews it; and (5) integrates the PII-review step into the verification workflow so it is required before any entry is published.
acceptanceCriteria: Decision tree or checklist covers: how to identify plausibly-private home addresses and personal phones in food-assistance listings
Preferred handling documented: prefer the operator's published public org channel (website contact form, public phone number, public address) over any personal/home details

Opt-out / approximate-area path defined: if a private individual's address/phone is the only available contact, show approximate area (e.g. neighborhood or zip) plus a public contact channel, not the exact personal details
pii_review field usage documented: 'clear' when no operator PII is exposed; 'operator-pii-minimized' when the opt-out/approximate-area path was applied
PII-review step is required before any entry is published (integrated into the verification checklist in docs/verification-log.md format)
The workflow notes that recipient/client PII is impossible by schema construction (no client fields exist) — operator PII is the only PII risk in this project
No recipient/client data path exists in any described workflow
Document reviewed and signed off by the privacy reviewer (distinct from the author)
output: docs/operator-pii-workflow.md (decision tree + policy document) and an update to the verification checklist template in docs/verification-log.md to include the pii_review step.
